"""Good: GET/HEAD toward the target; POST only to a passive third-party API (LINT-06)."""
from v3lum.core.models import Opsec


class LightProbe:
    name = "synthetic_light_probe"
    opsec = Opsec.LIGHT

    def run(self, entity, ctx):
        ctx.http.head(f"https://{entity.value}/")
        return ctx.http.get(f"https://{entity.value}/robots.txt")


class PassiveApi:
    name = "synthetic_passive_api"
    opsec = Opsec.PASSIVE

    def run(self, entity, ctx):
        return ctx.http.post_json("https://mb-api.abuse.ch/api/v1/", data={"query": "get_info", "hash": entity.value})
